La participación de las mujeres fue fundamental durante el movimiento de Independencia de México; por su lealtad a la patria, destacamos a Josefa Ortiz Téllez Girón, Antonia Nava y Gertrudis Bocanegra, así como heroínas anónimas que dieron ejemplo de convicción por las causas del pueblo.

Antonia Luisa Nava nació en 1779 en la villa de Tixtla, actual estado de Guerrero. En 1810 residía en Jaleaca con su esposo, tres hijas y cinco hijos. A finales de ese año, la guerra de Independencia se extendió por el sur del país con José María Morelos y Pavón. Antonia pronto destacó por su entrega a la causa con labores de cuidado y empuñando las armas, por lo que fue conocida como “la Generala”. Tras el fusilamiento de Morelos, Antonia siguió en la resistencia insurgente hasta el final de la guerra de Independencia. “La Generala” formó parte del desfile triunfal del Ejército de las Tres Garantías —también conocido como Ejército Trigarante— el 27 de septiembre de 1821 en la Ciudad de México. Se estableció en Chilpancingo, donde vivió hasta su fallecimiento el 19 de marzo de 1843.

وزیرِ اعظم نے پمز ہسپتال میں فائر سیفٹی سمیت نظام کی بہتری، اسکی بین الاقوامی تقاضوں سے ہم آہنگی اور انکوائری رپورٹ کی روشنی میں مجوزہ اقدامات کو آئندہ تین ماہ میں مکمل کرنے کی ہدایت کردی. وزیرِ اعظم محمد شہباز شریف کی زیر صدارت پمز ہسپتال کی بہتری کیلئے لائحہ عمل پر اجلاس آج اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہوا جس میں پمز تحقیقاتی رپورٹ اور وزارت قومی صحت کی جانب سے پمز کے پرفارمینس آڈٹ کا جائزہ لیا گیا. اجلاس سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ انکوائری رپورٹ میں مجوزہ قلیل مدتی اقدامات پر عملدرآمد کو آئندہ تین ماہ میں یقینی بنایا جائے. پمز ہسپتال میں بہتری اور اسے بین الاقوامی تقاضوں سے ہم آہنگ کرنے کیلئے ہر ممکن اقدام اٹھایا جائے. فائر سیفٹی سے متعلق نظام کیلئے پی کے ایل آئی (PKLI) سے معاونت اور تجاویز لی جائیں. وزیرِ اعظم نے مزید کہا کہ ڈبلیو ایچ او کی رپورٹ میں موجود تجاویز پر غور کر کے ان پر عملدرآمد بھی یقینی بنایا جائے. ہسپتال میں ادویات کی فراہمی اور سہولیات بالکل مفت فراہم کرنے کیلئے اقدامات بھی لائحہ عمل کا حصہ بنائے جائیں. پمز ہسپتال کی بہتری کیلئے اچھی شہرت کی حامل افرادی قوت کو تعینات کیا جائے. پمز ہسپتال کی بہتری کیلئے طویل مدتی اقدمات پر مبنی ایک جامع لائحہ عمل بھی مرتب کیا جائے. وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ پولی کلینک ہسپتال کا آڈٹ کرکے بے ضابطگیوں کو دور کیا جائے اور اسکی تنظیم نو کا لائحہ عمل مرتب کیا جائے. سی ڈی اے اسلام آباد میں موجود تمام سرکاری و نجی ہسپتالوں میں فائر سیفٹی اقدامات پر عملدرآمد یقینی بنائے. سی ڈی اے اور تمام متعلقہ ادارے سرکاری و نجی دفاتر و عمارتوں میں فائیر سیفٹی کے حوالے سے آڈٹ یقینی بنائیں. تمام دفاتر و عمارتوں میں فائر سیفٹی اقدامات پر عملدرآمد یقینی بنایا جائے. اجلاس کو وزارت قومی صحت کی جانب سے پمز ہسپتال کی بہتری اور اسے بین الاقوامی معیار سے ہم آہنگ کرنے کیلئے اقدامات پر بریفنگ دی گئی. اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ پمز ہسپتال کے پرفارمینس آڈٹ میں جانچ کردہ انڈیکیٹرز میں سے 90 فیصد کی قابل قبول ہدف کے مقابلے میں صرف 39.7 فیصد کمپلائنس پائی گئی. اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ پمز تحقیقاتی رپورٹ کی روشنی میں 37 مجوزہ اقدامات پر فوری عملدرآمد یقینی بنایا جارہا ہے جبکہ اجلاس کو قلیل، وسط اور طویل مدتی اقدامات پر بھی بریفنگ دی گئی. اجلاس میں وفاقی وزراء اعظم نذیر تارڑ، احد خان چیمہ، عطاء اللہ تارڑ، سید مصطفی کمال، معاون خصوصی مختار احمد بھرتھ اور متعلقہ اعلی حکام نے شرکت کی.

মালয়েশিয়ার শ্রমবাজারে এখনো নতুন করে কর্মী পাঠানোর বিষয়ে কোনো ঘোষণা আসেনি বলে জানিয়েছেন প্রবাসী কল্যাণ ও বৈদেশিক কর্মসংস্থান মন্ত্রণালয়ের সচিব মোখতার আহমেদ। এরমধ্যেই শুধু ২৫টি না; তালিকাভুক্ত ৩১২টিসহ সব বৈধ রিক্রুটিং এজেন্সিকে সমান সুযোগ দেয়ার দাবি জানিয়েছে বায়রার একাংশ। মালয়েশিয়ায় বিদেশি কর্মীদের নিয়োগ, ব্যবস্থাপনা ও তদারকির দায়িত্বে থাকা ফরেন ওয়ার্কার্স সেন্ট্রালাইজড ম্যানেজমেন্ট সিস্টেম- FWCMS অনলাইন প্লাটফর্মে বাংলাদেশি শ্রমিক পাঠাতে প্রথম ধাপে ২৫টি ও পরে আগস্টের শেষ দিকে ৩১৮টি রিক্রুটিং এজেন্সির তালিকা প্রকাশের পর গতি বাড়ে দেশটিতে শ্রমিক পাঠানোর কার্যক্রমে। তবে ঠিক কবে থেকে যাবে শ্রমিক, তার আগে শুরু হবে স্বাস্থ্য পরীক্ষা? এমন নানা প্রশ্ন যখন জোড়ালো হচ্ছে দিনকে দিন, তখন বুধবার প্রবাসী কল্যাণ ও বৈদেশিক কর্মসংস্থান মন্ত্রণালয়ের সচিব জানান, এখনও ঠিক হয়নি দিনক্ষণ। এদিন, মালয়েশিয়ার শ্রমবাজারে তালিকাভুক্তসহ সব বৈধ রিক্রুটিং এজেন্সির মাধ্যমে শ্রমিক পাঠানোর সুযোগ দিতে মন্ত্রী বরাবর স্মারকলিপি দেয় বায়রার একাংশ। তাদের দাবি, এতে সামনে আসবে না সিন্ডিকেট প্রশ্ন। এসময়, শ্রমবাজার যেন সিন্ডিকেটের কবলে না পড়ে সেদিকে সরকারের নজর রয়েছে বলে মন্ত্রণালয়ের পক্ষ থেকে আশ্বস্ত করা হয় এজেন্সি মালিকদের। #Malaysia #LaborMarket #OverseasEmployment #somoytv

পৃথিবীর পৃষ্ঠ থেকে প্রায় ২ হাজার ৯০০ কিলোমিটার গভীরে, ম্যান্টলের নিচের অংশে বিপুল পরিমাণ পানি খনিজের মধ্যে আটকে থাকতে পারে বলে নতুন গবেষণায় উঠে এসেছে। গবেষকরা উচ্চচাপ ও উচ্চতাপমাত্রার পরীক্ষায় দুটি নতুন আয়রন অক্সিহাইড্রক্সাইড: Fe₅O₁₂Hₓ ও Fe₇O₁₂Hₓ শনাক্ত করেছেন। এই খনিজগুলো গভীর ম্যান্টলের চরম পরিবেশে স্থিতিশীল থেকে বিপুল পরিমাণ পানি ধারণ করতে পারে। কিছু পরীক্ষায় পানির পরিমাণ ০.১ শতাংশেরও কম হলেও সামান্য হাইড্রোজেনের উপস্থিতি নতুন খনিজগুলোকে স্থিতিশীল করার জন্য যথেষ্ট ছিল। গবেষকদের ধারণা, পৃথিবীর প্রাথমিক ইতিহাসে গলিত ম্যাগমা মহাসাগর ঠান্ডা হয়ে স্ফটিকায়িত হওয়ার সময় এসব খনিজ তৈরি হয়ে গভীরে নেমে যেতে পারে। পরে ম্যান্টলের চলাচলের সঙ্গে এসব পানি-বহনকারী খনিজ ওপরে উঠলে চাপ কমে পানি অন্য খনিজ পর্যায়ে মুক্ত হতে পারে। সেই পানি ম্যান্টল প্লুম ও আগ্নেয়গিরির মাধ্যমে শেষ পর্যন্ত আবার পৃথিবীর পৃষ্ঠে ফিরে আসতে পারে। গবেষণাটি পৃথিবীর পানিচক্র যে কোর-ম্যান্টল সীমানা পর্যন্ত বিস্তৃত হতে পারে, সেই সম্ভাবনাও তুলে ধরছে। তবে এসব খনিজ বাস্তবে পৃথিবীর গভীরে ঠিক কতটা রয়েছে এবং সেখানে মোট কত পানি সংরক্ষিত আছে, তা এখনো নিশ্চিত নয়। #DeepEarth #WaterDiscovery #EarthScience #somoytv

An exhibition on Hyderabad Liberation Day was inaugurated at Parade Grounds, Secunderabad, by Shri Bandaru Dattatreya (@Dattatreya), Former Governor of Haryana. The event was graced by Shri Eatala Rajender (@Eatala_Rajender), MP Malkajgiri, Telangana, and Shri N. Ramchander Rao (@N_RamchanderRao), Former MLC, Telangana. Also present on the occasion were Shri Samar Nanda, Joint Secretary, MoC, Smt. Shruti Patil, IIS ADG, PIB & CBC, MIB, Hyderabad and Shri Rajeev Kumar, Director, MoC. Focusing on Operation Polo and its role in the integration of Hyderabad with the Union of India, the exhibition presents an important chapter in India’s history and will remain open till tomorrow, i.e. 17 September. #HyderabadLiberationDay

NITI Aayog hosted a brainstorming session with the Directors of IISERs on ‘Catalysing R&D in IISERs in India’, chaired by Prof. Gobardhan Das, Member, NITI Aayog. The session reviewed the research and innovation landscape of IISERs, including key findings from Clarivate Analytics and institutional perspectives on emerging opportunities and challenges. With the participation of the Secretary, Higher Education, discussions explored the proposed IISER Council, strengthening faculty and research capacity, and rationalising PhD fees to make doctoral education more attractive and comparable with leading premier institutions. The deliberations emphasised strengthening IISERs as centres of excellence in science, research and innovation, while fostering an enabling environment to attract and retain high-quality faculty, researchers and doctoral talent. The need to promote translational research and convert scientific discoveries into technologies and solutions with real-world impact was also highlighted. The session reaffirmed the commitment to a stronger, coordinated and globally competitive R&D ecosystem, with IISERs playing a greater role in India’s scientific and technological advancement. #IISER #ResearchAndInnovation #HigherEducation #ViksitBharat @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp @dasgobardhan

In Jaisalmer, Rajasthan, the Aspirational Districts Programme (ADP) is bringing hands-on science learning to 25 Government Schools, benefiting around 10,000 students from Classes 1–12. With science kits, microscopes, anatomy models, physics and chemistry resources, along with astronomy, space science, AR and VR tools, students are getting opportunities to explore, experiment and learn by doing. By taking science beyond textbooks and classrooms, the initiative is nurturing curiosity, critical thinking and problem-solving skills, while strengthening experiential STEM learning among students. #AspirationalDistrictsProgramme #ADP #Jaisalmer @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs Mr Shisir Khanal received H. E. Mr Naveen Srivastava, Ambassador of India to Nepal, for a farewell call at the Ministry this afternoon. On the occasion, Hon. Minister Khanal congratulated Ambassador Srivastava on the successful completion of his tenure while appreciating his efforts to further deepening multifaceted ties of Nepal-India relations. He highlighted major milestones in energy cooperation, trade, and infrastructure connectivity as well as people-to-people relations. Hon. Foreign Minister further expressed his deep gratitude for the solidarity and swift disaster relief support to Nepal in the aftermath of the disastrous floods in Bhote Koshi River. Hon. Foreign Minister also extended his best wishes to the Ambassador for his future endeavours and expressed confidence that he will continue to remain a good friend of Nepal. H. E. Mr Srivastava expressed his deep appreciation to the Government of Nepal for all the support and cooperation extended to him during his tenure and expressed hope that Nepal-India relations will continue to flourish in the days ahead.

H. E. Mr Naveen Srivastava, Ambassador of India to Nepal, paid a farewell call on Foreign Secretary Mr Amrit Bahadur Rai, at the Ministry today. On the occasion, the Foreign Secretary appreciated the contribution of the Ambassador in further strengthening Nepal-India relations and acknowledged his active role in achieving significant progress in the areas of energy, cross border infrastructure and people to people relations. He also extended his best wishes for his future endeavours. Ambassador Mr Srivastava expressed gratitude to the Government and people of Nepal for all the support and cooperation that he received during his tenure in Nepal.

Look at almost any public debate right now: cost of living, migration, climate, equality. These are difficult questions, and people genuinely disagree about what should be done. We're working through those disagreements at a time of deep polarization, with debate often reduced to opposing sides, anger and people talking past one another. These are the conditions in which democracy has to operate. What helps us navigate them? Deliberative democracy creates open and inclusive spaces where people can access reliable information, speak and participate safely, hear different perspectives, examine evidence and help shape decisions that affect their lives. Education for civic participation is part of this. Knowledge and critical thinking help people assess competing claims, engage constructively with disagreement and participate effectively in public life. Together, these conditions foster trust, protect human rights, strengthen democratic institutions and give people greater agency and ownership in democratic decision-making. This International Day of Democracy, the conversation continues towards the Forum on Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law in Geneva on 16–17 November, focused on education for civic participation. ohchr.org/en/events/sessions…

ইরান-যুক্তরাষ্ট্র চলমান যুদ্ধে মার্কিন সামরিক বাহিনীর ক্ষয়ক্ষতির আরও বিস্তারিত তথ্য প্রকাশ করা হবে বলে জানিয়েছেন ইরানের পররাষ্ট্রমন্ত্রী আব্বাস আরাঘচি। তিনি বলেছেন, যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের প্রতিরক্ষা দফতরের প্রকাশিত ক্ষয়ক্ষতির তথ্য ‘হিমশৈলের চূড়ামাত্র’। মঙ্গলবার (১৫ সেপ্টেম্বর) সামাজিক যোগাযোগমাধ্যম এক্সে দেওয়া এক পোস্টে আরাঘচি বলেন, ‘ইরান অরক্ষিত’—এটা একটা কল্পকাহিনি। তিনি পেন্টাগনের তথ্য উদ্ধৃত করে দাবি করেন, ইরানের হামলায় যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের শত শত সামরিক স্থাপনা ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত বা ধ্বংস হয়েছে এবং কয়েক ডজন মার্কিন সামরিক বিমান ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত হয়েছে। আরাঘচি বলেন, এসব তথ্যও প্রকৃত ক্ষয়ক্ষতির মাত্রার ‘হিমশৈলের চূড়ামাত্র’। উপযুক্ত সময়ে ইরান আরও বিস্তারিত তথ্য প্রকাশ করবে বলেও জানান তিনি। তিনি আরও বলেন, যারা ইরান সম্পর্কে মিথ্যা তথ্য প্রচার করেছে, তাদের জন্য সামনে বিষয়টি ‘সুন্দর হবে না’। যুদ্ধে মার্কিন সামরিক ক্ষয়ক্ষতির বিষয়ে ইরানের দাবির পাশাপাশি যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের নিজস্ব সরকারি নথিতেও উল্লেখযোগ্য ক্ষয়ক্ষতির তথ্য উঠে এসেছে। মার্কিন প্রতিরক্ষা দফতরের ইন্সপেক্টর জেনারেলের প্রতিবেদনে চলতি বছরের এপ্রিল থেকে জুন পর্যন্ত সময়ের তথ্য পর্যালোচনা করা হয়েছে। প্রতিবেদনে বলা হয়, ইরানি হামলায় কুয়েত, বাহরাইন, কাতার, সংযুক্ত আরব আমিরাত, সৌদি আরব, ইরাক, ওমান ও জর্ডানে থাকা মার্কিন ঘাঁটিগুলোর শত শত ভবন ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত বা ধ্বংস হয়েছে। প্রতিবেদন অনুযায়ী, মার্কিন সামরিক বিমান ও সরঞ্জামেরও বড় ধরনের ক্ষতি হয়েছে। এর মধ্যে ৩০টি পর্যন্ত এমকিউ-৯ রিপার ড্রোন এবং ৭টি কেসি-১৩৫ আকাশে জ্বালানি সরবরাহকারী বিমান হারানো বা ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত হওয়ার তথ্য উল্লেখ করা হয়েছে। এছাড়া প্রতিবেদনে বলা হয়েছে, যুদ্ধের প্রথম পর্যায়ের হিসাব অনুযায়ী যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের অপারেশন-সংক্রান্ত ব্যয় প্রায় ৩৩.৪ বিলিয়ন ডলারে পৌঁছেছে। এর মধ্যে প্রায় ৩.৭ বিলিয়ন ডলার হারানো বা ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত সামরিক সরঞ্জামের সঙ্গে সম্পর্কিত। মার্কিন সরকারি হিসাব অনুযায়ী, ইরানি হামলায় দেশটির কূটনৈতিক স্থাপনাগুলোরও ক্ষতি হয়েছে। এসব স্থাপনায় ক্ষতির পরিমাণ প্রায় ১৮৪ মিলিয়ন ডলার বলে জানানো হয়েছে। তথ্যসূত্র: ডন ও এপি #InternationalNews #Araghchi #IranWar #somoytv

ইরানের রেভল্যুশনারি গার্ড কোর বা আইআরজিসির নৌবাহিনী প্রধান রিয়ার অ্যাডমিরাল আলী ওজমায়ি দাবি করেছেন, কৌশলগতভাবে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ হরমুজ প্রণালি থেকে মার্কিন বাহিনীকে সরিয়ে দেওয়া হয়েছে এবং বর্তমানে প্রণালিটির নিয়ন্ত্রণ ইরানি বাহিনীর হাতে রয়েছে। বিস্তারিত : তেহরান টাইমসের বরাত দিয়ে ডন জানায়, মঙ্গলবার (১৫ সেপ্টেম্বর) চলমান ইরান-যুক্তরাষ্ট্র যুদ্ধের ২০০তম রাত উপলক্ষে দেওয়া এক বার্তায় ওজমায়ি এ দাবি করেন। তিনি এই সময়কে ইরানি জনগণের ধারাবাহিক প্রতিরোধ ও উপস্থিতির ২০০তম রাত হিসেবে উল্লেখ করেন। ওজমায়ি বলেন, ইরানের নৌবাহিনীর শক্তি ও দৃঢ়তার পেছনে দেশটির জনগণের প্রতিরোধ এবং অবিচল অবস্থান গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ভূমিকা রেখেছে। তিনি জনগণকে ঐক্য, সতর্কতা এবং সামরিক বাহিনী ও সরকারি কর্মকর্তাদের প্রতি সমর্থন অব্যাহত রাখার আহ্বান জানান। এর আগে ১১ সেপ্টেম্বরও ওজমায়ি বলেছিলেন, হরমুজ প্রণালি অবরুদ্ধ রয়েছে এবং ইরানি বাহিনী সেখানে গোয়েন্দা নজরদারি ও নিয়ন্ত্রণ বজায় রেখেছে। তবে হরমুজের নিয়ন্ত্রণ নিয়ে ইরান ও যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের মধ্যে পরস্পরবিরোধী দাবি রয়েছে। ওয়াশিংটনের পক্ষ থেকে বলা হয়েছে, প্রণালিটি উন্মুক্ত এবং মার্কিন নৌবাহিনী সেখানে জাহাজ চলাচলে সহায়তা করছে। সাম্প্রতিক তথ্যেও দেখা যাচ্ছে, হরমুজে বাণিজ্যিক জাহাজ চলাচল স্বাভাবিক সময়ের তুলনায় অনেক কম। রয়টার্সের আজ বুধবারের (১৬ সেপ্টেম্বর) তথ্য অনুযায়ী, মঙ্গলবার প্রণালিটি দিয়ে মাত্র চারটি জাহাজ চলাচল করেছে, যেখানে ১০ দিনের গড় ছিল ১৮টি। বিশ্বের অন্যতম গুরুত্বপূর্ণ জ্বালানি পরিবহনপথ হরমুজ প্রণালি দিয়ে স্বাভাবিক সময়ে বৈশ্বিক তেল ও তরলীকৃত প্রাকৃতিক গ্যাসের প্রায় এক-পঞ্চমাংশ পরিবাহিত হয়। ফলে প্রণালিকে ঘিরে ইরান ও যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের পাল্টাপাল্টি নিয়ন্ত্রণের দাবি আন্তর্জাতিক জ্বালানি বাজারে বড় প্রভাব ফেলছে। #news #update #somoytv

𝟏𝟓𝟎 𝐅𝐈𝐋𝐄𝐒 𝐌𝐈𝐒𝐒𝐈𝐍𝐆. 𝐀 𝐂𝐎𝐀𝐋 𝐒𝐂𝐀𝐌 𝐏𝐑𝐎𝐁𝐄. 𝐀𝐍𝐃 𝐂𝐎𝐍𝐆𝐑𝐄𝐒𝐒’ 𝐒𝐘𝐒𝐓𝐄𝐌 𝐖𝐈𝐓𝐇 𝐍𝐎 𝐀𝐍𝐒𝐖𝐄𝐑𝐒. 𝐓𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐃𝐚𝐲, 𝐓𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐘𝐞𝐚𝐫: 𝐒𝐞𝐩𝐭𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫 𝟏𝟔, 𝟐𝟎𝟏𝟑 On this day in 2013, the Union Coal Ministry submitted a report to the CBI on files missing from the coal-block allocation records. Nearly 150 files and documents were still awaited by investigators, while the CBI had identified more than 50 allocations for which records had not been received. Recent developments have raised questions about the Army’s commitment to scaling drone adoption. But doing so, and at pace, is critical for future military success, argues expert @mchorowitz. First, there were reports last month that U.S. military units fared poorly against Ukrainian drone units in an exercise in Germany earlier this year. This was followed by news that the Army will phase out a specialized drone unit created less than a year ago to improve the service’s drone capabilities. Finally, last month saw the resignation of U.S. Secretary of the Army Daniel Driscoll, the Army’s most prominent remaining champion of transforming the service for an age of precise mass—meaning that relatively cheap, highly accurate, uncrewed systems are deployed at scale. “If the Army is going to continue evolving to meet new threats as they emerge, it will need to keep accelerating not just the acquisition of drones, but their integration into units around the world. Adoption, more than the acquisition of technology, is the difference between winning and losing in war,” Horowitz writes.

Frontier models disrupting traditional security fields i.e. vulnerability discovery and exploitation at scale, sandbox escapes during safety evaluations 3. Evolving risks from autonomous agents i.e. OpenClaw and other "high privilege" agents that can become “Trojan horses” for cyberattacks 4. We are deeply concerned by reports of another potential case of transnational repression in Costa Rica. Reinaldo Picado Miranda was reportedly shot multiple times by two unidentified assailants in what appears to have been an attempted assassination in San José. A former member of the Contra forces, Picado Miranda was facing extradition following allegations by the Ortega-Murillo regime linking him to the death of a police officer in Nicaragua. He had also reported a previous attack against him in Costa Rica's Cartago province in June 2026 and publicly held the Nicaraguan authorities responsible. Nicaraguan civil society organizations in Costa Rica fear this incident may be part of a broader pattern of surveillance, harassment, intimidation, and attacks targeting Nicaraguan dissidents living in exile. We urge Costa Rican authorities to conduct a prompt, thorough, and impartial investigation and to ensure the protection of those at risk for exercising their fundamental rights and freedoms. Small and medium-sized enterprises are essential to the first mile of food systems, connecting farmers to markets through production, processing, distribution and trade. Yet many struggle to access the finance needed to grow. IFAD works to close this financing gap, using investment to strengthen rural businesses, increase productivity and build resilience while creating opportunities for private capital to participate in underserved markets. In Uganda, IFAD-supported the Yield Uganda Investment Fund that brings together public and private investors to provide tailored finance to agricultural SMEs. Among them, Kamp Feed Limited received US$2.6 million in equity and loans to build a new factory, including two silos with capacity for up to 3,500 tons of grain. Because the company sources from small scale farmers, the investment creates benefits beyond the business itself, giving suppliers a stronger market for their produce and helping them increase their incomes and invest in their farms. In Cabo Verde, investment through the IFAD-funded Rural Socio Economic Opportunities Programme helped the “Força de Vontade” farm expand production, acquire a vehicle and reach supermarkets, hotels and customers directly. Hydroponic technology also reduced water use by 50%, strengthening the business against drought. Today, the farm spans nearly 1,000 square metres and employs 10 people, demonstrating how targeted finance can help rural SMEs grow while generating wider economic opportunities for their communities. জাপানের রাজধানী টোকিওতে সাবেক প্রেমিকের ভাড়া করা একটি ফ্ল্যাট থেকে ম'র'দে'হ উদ্ধার করা হয়েছে ২৫ বছর বয়সী মডেল ও অভিনেত্রী হানা কুরাকির। শনিবার (১২ সেপ্টেম্বর) তার মরদেহ উদ্ধারের পর শোবিজ পাড়ায় শুরু হয়েছে আতঙ্ক। এদিকে পুলিশ জানিয়েছে, অভিনেত্রী হানা কুরাকির মৃ'ত্যু'র আগে লেখা একটি চিরকুট পাওয়া গেছে। ওই চিরকুটে সাবেক প্রেমিক শোতা তাইরার বিরুদ্ধে গুরুতর অভিযোগ রয়েছে তার। তাই হানা কুরাকির মৃ'ত্যু'র প্রকৃত কারণ এবং তার সাবেক প্রেমিককে ঘিরে ওঠা অভিযোগ খতিয়ে দেখছে তদন্তকারীরা। #NewsUpdate #news #somoytv

প্রধানমন্ত্রী তারেক রহমানের ঘোষণার পর জাতীয় গ্রিডে গ্যাস সরবরাহ বেড়েছে। বাংলাদেশ তেল, গ্যাস ও খনিজসম্পদ করপোরেশনের (পেট্রোবাংলা) সমন্বিত ব্যবস্থাপনায় দেশীয় উৎস থেকে প্রাপ্ত গ্যাসের পাশাপাশি আমদানি হওয়া তরলীকৃত প্রাকৃতিক গ্যাসে (এলএনজি) সরবরাহ বাড়ানো হয়েছে। মঙ্গলবার (১৫ সেপ্টেম্বর) বিকেল ৪টায় জাতীয় গ্রিডে মোট ২৬০ দশমিক ৬ কোটি ঘনফুট গ্যাস সরবরাহ করা হয়েছে। পেট্রোবাংলার পরিচালক (অপারেশনস অ্যান্ড মাইনস) প্রকৌশলী মো. শোয়েব এ তথ্য নিশ্চিত করেছেন। তিনি জানান, বিকেল ৪টায় জাতীয় গ্রিডে ২৬০ দশমিক ৬ কোটি ঘনফুট গ্যাস সরবরাহ করা হয়েছে। জাতীয় গ্রিডে গ্যাসের প্রাপ্যতা বৃদ্ধিতে দেশীয় উৎসের উৎপাদন এবং আমদানিকৃত এলএনজি সরবরাহের মধ্যে সমন্বয় করে গ্যাস সরবরাহ করা হচ্ছে বলেও জানান তিনি। পেট্রোবাংলার তথ্যানুযায়ী, মঙ্গলবার বিকেল ৪টায় সরবরাহ করা মোট গ্যাসের মধ্যে দেশীয় উৎস থেকে এসেছে ১৬১ দশমিক ৫ কোটি ঘনফুট এবং এলএনজি থেকে সরবরাহ হয়েছে ৯৯ দশমিক ১ কোটি ঘনফুট। পেট্রোবাংলা সূত্র অনুযায়ী, দেশে দৈনিক গ্যাসের চাহিদা প্রায় ৩৫০ কোটি ঘনফুট। #NewsUpdate #news #nationalnews #somoytv

ইতালিতে হামলা: খোঁজ নিতে বাঁধনের বাসায় পররাষ্ট্র প্রতিমন্ত্রী ইতালিতে আওয়ামী লীগ সমর্থকদের হামলার শিকার অভিনেত্রী আজমেরী হক বাঁধন ও তার স্বজনদের সঙ্গে সাক্ষাৎ করেছেন পররাষ্ট্র প্রতিমন্ত্রী হুমায়ুন কবির। মঙ্গলবার (১৫ সেপ্টেম্বর) রাতে ফেসবুকে দেয়া এক পোস্টে এ তথ্য জানিয়েছেন অভিনেত্রী নিজেই। তিনি জানান, প্রধানমন্ত্রীর পক্ষ থেকে পররাষ্ট্র প্রতিমন্ত্রী তার বাসায় গিয়ে পরিবারের সদস্যদের খোঁজ-খবর নেন। সামাজিক যোগাযোগমাধ্যম ফেসবুকের এক পোস্টে বাঁধন পররাষ্ট্র প্রতিমন্ত্রী হুমায়ুন কবিরের প্রতি কৃতজ্ঞতা প্রকাশ করেন। পোস্টে তিনি লিখেছেন, আজ আমার ও আমার পরিবারের খোঁজ নিতে আমাদের বাসায় এসেছিলেন প্রধানমন্ত্রী তারেক রহমানের পক্ষ থেকে পররাষ্ট্র প্রতিমন্ত্রী হুমায়ুন কবির সাহেব। তার এই আন্তরিকতা, সৌজন্য এবং দায়িত্বশীলতার জন্য আমি গভীরভাবে সম্মানিত ও কৃতজ্ঞ। বাঁধন আরও লিখেছেন, ‘এই কঠিন সময়ে রাষ্ট্রের পক্ষ থেকে আমাদের পাশে দাঁড়ানোর এই উদ্যোগ আমাকে ব্যক্তিগতভাবে যেমন আশ্বস্ত করেছে, তেমনি একজন নাগরিক হিসেবে রাষ্ট্রের প্রতি আমার আস্থাকেও আরও দৃঢ় করেছে।’ #NewsUpdate #news #nationalnews #somoytv

Senior military commanders from the U.S., Israel and eight Arab countries secretly met in Germany last week to discuss the war with Iran and the broader regional security situation. Axios reports the meeting, organized by CENTCOM commander Adm. Brad Cooper, included the military chiefs of Israel, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, Jordan and Egypt. It was the first such gathering since the U.S. and Israel went to war with Iran more than six months ago, and brought together Israeli and Arab military leaders from countries that in some cases still have no diplomatic relations. Cooper reportedly reassured the group that the U.S. will maintain its military presence in the region and briefed them on plans to expand protected shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. The meeting also comes as the Houthis escalate attacks on Saudi Arabia and threaten the Bab al-Mandab. Video purporting to show the Panama flagged, Qatar owned oil tanker El Gaia with black smoke rising from its superstructure is circulating online following an apparent attack on the vessel near Oman on September 13. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed the tanker struck a naval mine while making what it described as an unauthorized transit. That account has been disputed by U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM), which says the vessel was previously struck by an Iranian missile and was later attacked by an Iranian drone while off the coast of Oman. The available video does not appear to show obvious hull damage consistent with a mine explosion. India’s Ministry of External Affairs confirmed that 13 of the 14 Indian crew members aboard were rescued, with one Indian national remaining missing. Oman has since reported that 23 crew members were evacuated from the tanker, while search operations continue for two missing crew members. The vessel is being towed toward Oman. Video

The new granite helipad on the White House South Lawn is now complete, paving the way for the U.S. Marine Corps’ VH-92A "Patriot" to routinely operate as "Marine One" from the White House grounds. The VH-92A had seen limited use for White House arrivals and departures because its downward directed exhaust can generate enough heat to scorch or damage the South Lawn. The Marine Corps had therefore continued using the older VH-3D helicopter for South Lawn operations. President Donald J. Trump approved construction of the permanent landing pad, with Sikorsky, the VH-92A manufacturer and a Lockheed Martin subsidiary, providing approximately $5 million to fund the project. The VH-92A is intended to replace the legacy presidential helicopter fleet and provide the president with secure presidential airlift for both routine and contingency operations. O Brasil está dando mais um passo para fortalecer sua economia digital. Sancionei hoje o Redata, um regime especial que cria incentivos para a instalação e ampliação de datacenters no país e pode contribuir para atrair investimentos e ampliar nossa capacidade em áreas como inteligência artificial, computação em nuvem e outras tecnologias digitais. Atualmente, a maioria dos dados e serviços digitais usados no Brasil é processada fora do país. Com o Redata, queremos ampliar essa capacidade aqui dentro, sob as nossas leis e com mais soberania sobre os nossos dados. E quem receber incentivo público vai ter que dar retorno ao país: investir no Brasil o equivalente a 2% do valor dos equipamentos beneficiados em pesquisa, desenvolvimento e inovação, reservar pelo menos 10% da capacidade de processamento, armazenagem e tratamento de dados para o mercado nacional e cumprir regras de alta eficiência no uso da água e de energia limpa e de baixa emissão. O programa também cria condições mais favoráveis para investimentos no Norte, Nordeste e Centro-Oeste, contribuindo para ampliar a presença da infraestrutura digital em diferentes regiões do Brasil. O Redata faz parte do esforço para fortalecer nossa capacidade tecnológica, estimular inovação e gerar novas oportunidades de desenvolvimento no país. 📸 @ricardostuckert

نے برآمدی صنعتوں کے لیے جدید ٹیکنالوجی، تحقیق اور جدت کو فروغ دینے کی ہدایت کی. انہوں نے کہا کہ ملکی معیشت کو جدید تقاضوں سے ہم آہنگ کرنے کے لیے ڈیجیٹلائزیشن اور جدید ٹیکنالوجی سے بھرپور استفادہ کیا جائے. برآمد کنندگان کو درپیش انتظامی اور کاروباری رکاوٹیں دور کی جائیں اور برآمدی عمل کو مزید آسان، تیز اور شفاف بنایا جائے. اجلاس میں برآمدات کے فروغ کیلئے منظور شدہ اسٹرٹیجک روڈ میپ پر عملدرآمد سے متعلق پیشرفت پر بریفنگ دی گئی اور نئی عالمی منڈیوں تک رسائی، برآمدی شعبوں میں تنوع، مصنوعات کے معیار میں بہتری اور کاروباری سہولت کاری کے حوالے سے مختلف تجاویز کا جائزہ لیا گیا۔ اجلاس میں برآمدی شعبوں کی عالمی سطح پر مسابقتی صلاحیت بہتر بنانے پر بھی تفصیلی غور کیا گیا. بریفنگ میں بتایا گیا کہ عالمی مارکیٹ تک پاکستانی مصنوعات کی رسائی بڑھانے کے لئے متعدد دوست ممالک سے فری ٹریڈ ایگریمنٹ اور رعایتی نرخوں پر تجارت کے معاہدوں کے لیے اقدامات لیے جا رہے ہیں. پاکستانی ہارٹیکلچرل مصنوعات کو برآمدات میں شامل کرنے کے لیے اقدامات لیے جا رہے ہیں. پاکستانی سرجیکل اور میڈیکل آلات کی برآمدات بڑھانے کیلئے بین الاقوامی ہسپتالوں کے ٹینڈرز اور پروکیورمنٹ میں پاکستانی ایکسپورٹرز کی شمولیت کی حوصلہ افزائی کی جا رہی ہے. بریفنگ میں مزید بتایا گیا کہ عالمی کمپنیوں کو پاکستانی مصنوعات سے روشناس کرانے کے لیے ٹیکسپو (TEXPO)، ہیلتھ انجینئرنگ اینڈ منرلز شو، فوڈ اینڈ ایگریکلچر (FoodAg) اور دیگر شعبوں سے متعلق نمائشیں ملک کے مختلف شہروں میں منعقد کی جا رہی ہیں. برآمدات میں جدت کو فروغ دینے کے لیے انٹیلیکچؤل پراپرٹی قوانین کو دور حاضر کے تقاضوں ہم آہنگ کرنے پر کام جاری ہے. ایکسپورٹ ڈویلپمنٹ فنڈ کی تنظیم نو کا عمل مکمل ہو چکا ہے اور ای ڈی ایف کی جانب سے کاروباری برادری کے لیے سہولت کے حوالے سے اقدامات لیے جا رہے ہیں. اجلاس میں نائب وزیراعظم و وزیر خارجہ محمد اسحاق ڈار، وفاقی وزراء رانا تنویر حسین، جام کمال خان، ڈاکٹر مصدق مسعود ملک، احد خان چیمہ، محمد اورنگزیب، مشیر وزیراعظم ہارون اختر، وزیر مملکت برائے خزانہ بلال اظہر کیانی اور متعلقہ اداروں کے اعلیٰ افسران شریک تھے۔ Video

وزیراعظم شہبازشریف سےگورنرخیبر پختونخوا فیصل کریم کنڈی کی آج اسلام آباد میں ملاقات ہوئی. ملاقات کے دوران صوبے کے مجموعی سیاسی حالات، امن و امان، اور باہمی دلچسپی کے امور پر تفصیلی تبادلہء خیال کیا گیا۔ وزیرِ اعظم نے اس بات کا اعادہ کیا کہ وفاقی حکومت خیبر پختونخوا کی ترقی اور صوبے کے عوام کی فلاح و بہبود کے لیے کام جاری رکھے گی۔ ملاقات میں وفاق اور صوبے کے درمیان ہم آہنگی اور عوامی مسائل کو حل کرنے کے لیے مزید کوششوں پر بھی زور دیا گیا۔ ملاقات میں وفاقی وزیر برائے امورِ کشمیر و گلگت بلتستان انجینئر امیر مقام اور وزیرِ اعظم کے مشیر برائے سیاسی امور رانا ثناء اللہ بھی موجود تھے۔

وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف سے چیئرمین نیشنل ڈیزاسٹر مینجمنٹ اتھارٹی (NDMA) لیفٹیننٹ جنرل انعام حیدر ملک کی ملاقات ہوئی. لیفٹیننٹ جنرل انعام حیدر ملک نے وزیراعظم کو حالیہ مون سون سیزن میں شدید بارشوں اور ممکنہ سیلابی صورتحال سے نبرد آزما ہونے کے لئے پیشگی انتظامات پر بریف کیا. وزیرِ اعظم نے ہدایت کی کہ بارشوں سے متاثرہ علاقوں میں عوام کو ہر ممکن امداد اور ریلیف فراہم کرنے کے لیے تمام دستیاب وسائل بروئے کار لائے جائیں. بارشوں کے دوران رابطہ سڑکوں اور پلوں پر ٹریفک کی روانی یقینی بنانے اور امدادی سامان کی ترسیل کے حوالے سے متعلقہ محکموں کے ساتھ روابط بڑھائے جائیں. وزیر اعظم نے این ڈی ایم اے کو متعلقہ صوبائی اداروں اور پی ڈی ایم ایز کے ساتھ موثر رابطہ رکھنے کی ہدایت بھی جاری کی. چیئرمین این ڈی ایم اے نے کہا کہ وزیراعظم کے ہدایت کردہ پیشگی انتظامات کے باعث متعلقہ ادارے اس مون سون سیزن کی موثر اقدامات کے ساتھ بہتر انداز میں نگرانی کر سکے. انہوں نے وزیراعظم کو جاری مون سون سیزن کے متوقع رجحان اور صوبوں اور ادراوں کے باہمی تعاون سے جاری مجموعی انتظامات کی صورتحال سے آگاہ کرتے ہوئے بتایا کہ ملک کے طول و عرض میں کسی بھی ہنگامی موسمی صورتحال کے پیش نظر تمام متعلقہ ادارے ریسکیو اور ریلیف کے لئے تیار ہیں.

Dr. Joram Aniya, Member, NITI Aayog, along with officers from NITI Aayog, visited Meghalaya to engage with the State Government and understand key development priorities, sectoral initiatives and promising practices that can be strengthened and scaled. The State showcased innovative interventions across sports and sports science, ecological conservation, education, healthcare and organic agriculture. At the SAI Centre at NEHU, Sports Science Center and Army Boys Sports Company in Shillong, Dr. Aniya interacted with athletes and coaches across disciplines including archery, football, wushu and boxing. At Siej village, Dr. Aniya visited a living Root Bridge and interacted with Shri Hally War, farmer and environmentalist and Padma Shri awardee, to learn about efforts to preserve Meghalaya’s traditional living root bridges. In Ri Bhoi, an Aspirational District, she visited the Northeast’s first organic processing facility for dried ginger and turmeric. The visit also included interactions with frontline health workers at PHCs and Sub-Centres, along with visits to the Chief Minister’s Youth Centre and Eklavya Model Residential School, providing insights into grassroots initiatives in health, skilling and education. The engagement highlighted opportunities to build on Meghalaya’s strengths through innovation, sustainability and inclusive growth, while addressing existing challenges and supporting the State’s development priorities towards Viksit Bharat@2047. #Meghalaya #NITI4Development #ViksitBharat2047 @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

Dr. Joram Aniya, Member, NITI Aayog, engaged with the leadership and senior officers of the Government of Meghalaya to discuss the State’s development priorities, sectoral initiatives and best practices. माननीय रक्षा मंत्री ने 'डिफेंस सिस्टम्स फॉर रेजिलिएंट भारत – रक्षा में आत्मनिर्भरता की ओर’ नाम की एक किताब का विमोचन भी किया गया। इस किताब में 2014 से 2026 के दौरान DRDO द्वारा विकसित महत्वपूर्ण रक्षा प्रणालियों का विवरण दिया गया है, साथ ही DRDO में ‘मानव संसाधन आउटसोर्सिंग सेवा अनुबंधों के लिए दिशानिर्देश’ भी शामिल हैं। इसके अतिरिक्त इंडस्ट्री की पहुँच बढ़ाने और ज़मीनी स्तर पर भागीदारी को बढ़ावा देने के लिए 'सोसाइटी ऑफ़ इंडियन डिफेंस मैन्युफ़ैक्चरर्स' (SIDM) और 'लघु उद्योग भारती' (LUB) के साथ भी औपचारिक रूप से रणनीतिक MoU (समझौता ज्ञापन) किए गए। DRDO ने घरेलू रक्षा कंपनियों की मैन्युफ़ैक्चरिंग मैच्योरिटी (निर्माण परिपक्वता) को मापने के लिए 'क्वालिटी काउंसिल ऑफ़ इंडिया' के साथ 'सिस्टम फ़ॉर एडवांस्ड मैन्युफ़ैक्चरिंग असेसमेंट एंड रेटिंग' (SAMAR) वर्जन 2.0 के लिए एक कॉन्ट्रैक्ट पर भी हस्ताक्षर किए।

A recent article on @CNBCTV18Live draws on the ICRIER working paper, “𝗘𝗨 𝗦𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗮𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗥𝗲𝗴𝘂𝗹𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀: 𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗜𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗮’𝘀 𝗥𝗶𝗰𝗲 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝘀” to explain why India's rice exports keep hitting regulatory cracks in the EU market with 92% of its basmati-heavy EU trade at stake. Of the rice India shipped to the EU, 52 consignments were flagged in 2025, and about one rejection for every 9,100 tonnes. The ICRIER study traces the problem to an accountability gap, with oversight split between APEDA and the Export Inspection Council and no clear division of responsibility. Most rejections stem from pesticide residues banned in the EU but still used in India. Its recommendation: consolidate export oversight under a single nodal agency with end-to-end traceability. 📰 ICRIER in the News A recent article in The Hindu @businessline features an ICRIER’s working paper 𝗘𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗘𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗼𝘆𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗶𝗻 𝗜𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗮’𝘀 𝗖𝘂𝗹𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗮𝗹 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗖𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗘𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗼𝗺𝘆: 𝗘𝘃𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗣𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗼𝗱𝗶𝗰 𝗟𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗙𝗼𝗿𝗰𝗲 𝗦𝘂𝗿𝘃𝗲𝘆. The working paper gives a systematic estimate of employment in India's cultural and creative economy. It also finds that the sector now employs about 57 million people, having added over 16 million jobs (a 40% rise) between 2017-18 and 2025. A busy start to the political week here in Kyiv: Ukraine's prosecutor general, Ruslan Kravchenko, appointed by Zelenskyy last year with backing of his then-chief of staff now accused of corruption Andriy Yermak, has resigned and fled Ukraine after becoming embroiled in a corruption scandal of his own. Kravchenko's appointment was part of Zelenskyy's ultimately disastrous effort to bring Ukraine's independent anti-corruption agencies NABU and SAPO under tight presidential control through Kravchenko's oversight — a move that backfired spectacularly last summer, triggering the country's first and largest public protests since Russia's full-scale invasion. Now Kravchenko himself is facing scrutiny from those very agencies, who've charged several of his subordinates in the prosecutor general's office in an alleged fraud scheme. Before resigning and fleeing, he moved against their directors by signing off charges against them. Zelenskyy has called on parliament to swiftly approve Kravchenko's dismissal.

STATEMENT BY PRESIDENT RAMAPHOSA ON KILLINGS OF WOMEN IN THE EAST RAND President @CyrilRamaphosa has said that no stone will be left unturned to solve the recent killings of women in and around Kempton Park in Gauteng. He said: “I speak for all of us as I extend my deepest condolences to all families and communities affected by the killing of women recently found in and around Kempton Park. “These incidents are causing fear and uncertainty in our communities, and especially among women. “As government, we share the concerns of all South Africans, and we mourn the lives so cruelly taken away. “Our law enforcement agencies are working urgently to establish the facts, keep communities safe, and bring the perpetrator or perpetrators to justice. “I have spoken to the Minister of Police and the Acting National Police Commissioner, who have briefed me on the investigation. I have directed that these cases be prioritised and that no stone be left unturned in bringing those responsible to justice. “Our law enforcement agencies are undertaking this work in partnership with citizens, on whom we depend for any information that may help end these attacks on women. “As a nation, we must stand up for the rights, safety and dignity of women and girls. “As we do so, our hearts go out to all the families affected by the terrible events in the Kempton Park area. “If anyone has information about these incidents or if you are missing a relative or friend, please contact Warrant Officer Elvis Manyike on 082 465 7249.” ISSUED BY THE PRESIDENCY OF THE REPUBLIC OF SOUTH AFRICA

Four years after I launched @IAEAorg’s #RaysOfHope, we are translating the promise of nuclear science into cancer care for people who previously had little or no access to it. More than 100 countries are receiving support, over 150 pieces of major cancer diagnosis and treatment equipment have been procured, and more than 170 specialized medical professionals have started long-term training. But the real measure of progress is not just equipment delivered. It is people receiving care where that care did not exist before. And indeed the need remains enormous: in 2024, 20.6 million people were diagnosed with cancer and nearly 10 million died from the disease. That’s exactly why our ambition goes beyond delivering machines: we want to help countries build the people, institutions and capabilities needed to provide safe, high-quality cancer care for the long term. Our 21 #RaysOfHope Anchor Centres, with Singapore joining just yesterday, are central to this effort. Now we must build on this momentum and scale up our work: governments, cancer centres, development and financing institutions and the private sector all have a role to play so we can extend the reach and impact of #RaysOfHope to many more patients. Where someone is born or where they live should not determine whether they can receive the cancer diagnosis and treatment that could save their life. Grateful to Tanzania VP Deogratius John Ndejembi and @TheOPECFund President Abdulhamid Alkhalifa for joining me to open the #IAEAGC Scientific Forum, as well as to all the ministers attending, in a clear sign of the growing commitment to turning this ambition into reality. 40 yrs ago, Iranians were victims of chemical weapons while the world watched. On Feb 28, Lamerd became a testing ground for new barbaric weapons. We must ensure that those who committed this war crime—& those who knowingly enabled them—are brought to justice #JusticeForLamerd Reza Nasri (@RezaNasri1) Today, I stood in Lamerd. I had read the reports. I had studied the forensic reconstructions by Airwars, The New York Times, BBC Verify, the painstaking work on trajectory angles, fragmentation patterns and blast radii. None of it prepared me for standing beneath these walls, or meeting the people who live behind them. Lamerd is a small city of about 30,000 people in Fars province. It is the kind of place where a stranger is offered food before anyone asks his name. I have rarely encountered a community so instinctively and openly hospitable. People who had only recently buried their children still insisted on pouring us tea. That warmth, in the face of what was done to them, is the first thing the world should know about Lamerd. The second is what these walls tell you, if you take the time to look. On February 28, 2026, the opening day of the US-Israeli war on Iran, the United States fired Precision Strike Missiles into this city. Independent forensic reconstruction has identified at least three. Eye witnesses say there were four. The PrSM is not an ordinary missile. It does not simply strike a point on the ground. It detonates in the air, roughly fifteen to twenty metres above the surface, turning the area beneath it into a killing zone. The blast sends tens of thousands of white-hot tungsten fragments in every direction, ripping through walls, cars and human bodies. Investigators counted more than 2,000 individual fragment impacts along a single 150-metre stretch of one residential street. I walked that street today. I did not need the number. I could see it. Look at the photographs. The facades are not simply damaged. They are pocked from roofline to foundation, in a pattern no accident could produce. The asphalt of the schoolyard is covered with hundreds of small grey scars where fragments struck the pavement. Then there is the steel door. The kind of door you would find on any modest home. It has been punched through in a dozen places. Taped above the holes is a photograph of a curly-haired toddler. Her name was Avina Barzegar. She was two years old. She was killed in her family's backyard. This is how the attack was described to us by people who lived through it. A missile struck first, directly above the Shahid Naimi sports hall, where a girls' volleyball team was training. Panic followed. People did what people instinctively do when something explodes nearby: they ran outside, toward the open air, believing that was where they might be safe. That was when the second missile came down. Then a third. Then a fourth. Each detonated over a different part of the same small city: a school, a residential area, places where people had run because they thought the street was safer than the building they had been inside. At least 21 civilians were killed that day, including children as young as two. More than 170 were wounded. Spinal injuries. Amputations. Catastrophic burns. We met the family of a seventeen-year-old girl who lost both eyes. We met the family of another young girl who will spend the rest of her life in a wheelchair, her spine severed by fragments that fell from a clear afternoon sky. I heard about a little girl who no longer speaks. The trauma and bleeding in her brain took her voice, along with so much of what childhood was supposed to give her. None of these girls carried a rifle. None wore a uniform. Among those killed and maimed in Lamerd, there was not a single member of an armed force, Iranian or otherwise. According to the forensic reconstruction, the missiles were launched from mobile batteries in a Persian Gulf Arab state that hosts American forces, a state that would later condemn Iran when Iran exercised its inherent right of self-defense. And what was Washington's response? It was not that Lamerd contained a military target. No such target has ever been identified by CENTCOM. Instead, the story changed. First, a CENTCOM spokesman flatly said that no American strike had taken place within thirty miles of Lamerd that day. Then footage emerged that could no longer be dismissed. The explanation changed. The missile seen in the footage, they said, was actually an Iranian Hoveyzeh cruise missile. Weapons analysts at Janes and McKenzie Intelligence, along with the visual-forensics teams at The New York Times and BBC Verify, examined the same footage independently. They reached the same conclusion. The silhouette, the mid-air detonation and the fragmentation pattern all pointed to one weapon used in that theater. It was not Iranian. None of this should surprise anyone who has followed this war closely. The PrSM had never been used in combat before February 28. Lamerd was its combat debut. A live-fire demonstration in a civilian city, whose geography apparently made it a convenient proving ground. And by the Pentagon's own measure, the test was a success. Within a month, Lockheed Martin had reached a new agreement with the Department of War to quadruple PrSM production, later reported by independent investigators to be worth some $8.4 billion. Days after the missile killed Avina Barzegar, CENTCOM commander Adm. Brad Cooper publicly celebrated its combat debut, calling it "an unrivaled deep strike capability." Tell that to the toddler on the door. Iranian civil society will not allow what happened in Lamerd to disappear the way so much of Iraq and Afghanistan disappeared from public memory. Those societies had their bar associations, universities and forensic institutions hollowed out by decades of dictatorship, invasion and war before anyone expected them to build a serious case file. Iran does not face those same constraints. It has tens of thousands of practicing lawyers, a functioning forensic medicine system, land and hospital registries, dozens of law faculties, and a diaspora that includes lawyers admitted to practice in jurisdictions that recognize universal jurisdiction. We will use every one of them. We will pursue Donald Trump, Marco Rubio, Pete Hegseth, Adm. Brad Cooper, and every officer who executed their orders, in every forum on this earth that will hear us, for as long as it takes. This is not only Iran's fight. People anywhere, including in the United States and Europe, can do something about it. 1- Pursue universal jurisdiction. If you live in a country that recognizes universal jurisdiction over grave breaches of the Geneva Conventions, press prosecutors to open a file. Many of these governments speak constantly about the independence of their judiciaries. This is where that claim gets tested. The legal basis exists. The precedents exist. 2- Demand an end to the contracts: Demand that your government, and any government with a Lockheed Martin contract, cancel it. Every state party to the Geneva Conventions has obligations to "ensure respect" for international humanitarian law. Those obligations do not disappear because a weapons contract is profitable. A company should not be able to field-test a weapon on a residential street and then collect billions of dollars to manufacture more of it. 3- Say their names. Be loud. Organize. Say Avina Barzegar's name. Say the names of the other children killed on that street. Keep saying them until they cannot be forgotten. Let Lamerd become the case that finally forces the world to confront this weapon and ban its use against civilians, so that no city anywhere becomes someone else's proving ground again. And do not accept, for one second, the claim that this is "still under investigation." This is a government that has told the American public that it can read an Iranian officer's name tag from a satellite in orbit. It closed the Lamerd file within days, through denial, without answering the questions raised by BBC Verify, The New York Times or Airwars. An administration with that level of claimed surveillance capability does not need more time to determine who fired four missiles into a city of 30,000 people. It has known since the morning of February 28. It has decided that the truth is inconvenient. Avina Barzegar was two years old. That is why we do not stop. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/RezaNasri1/status/2098781595360518197#m

War crimes and crimes against humanity are not erased by political narratives, military necessity or passage of time. International law is clear: Those who order, commit, facilitate, or knowingly enable such crimes bear individual criminal responsibility. #JusticeforLamerd Reza Nasri (@RezaNasri1) An Open Letter to @LockheedMartin To James D. Taiclet, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, and to the Board of Directors. I have just returned from Lamerd, a city of thirty thousand in Iran's Fars province. On 28 February 2026, the opening day of the American and Israeli war on Iran, United States forces fired Precision Strike Missiles built by your corporation into its residential streets, its school and its sports hall. Twenty-one civilians were killed. More than one hundred and seventy were wounded — among them children who will live the rest of their lives without sight, without limbs, or without the use of their spines. The youngest of the dead was Avina Barzegar. She was two. Her photograph is taped above the fragment holes in her family's steel door. I have stood in front of it. Within a month, your corporation signed an agreement to quadruple production of the weapon that did this, reported at some $8.4 billion. I write because the legal consequences of having done so knowingly are more serious than your officers appear to have been advised. What occurred at Lamerd was a war crime. There was no military objective. Under the customary rule reflected in Article 52(2) of Additional Protocol, an object may be attacked only where it effectively contributes to military action and its destruction offers a definite military advantage. In six months, Central Command has identified no such object in Lamerd. It first claimed no American strike occurred within thirty miles of the city. When video made that untenable, it claimed the munition was an Iranian cruise missile, a claim rejected independently by Janes, McKenzie Intelligence, The New York Times and BBC Verify, each identifying the silhouette, the airburst and the fragmentation pattern of one weapon in that theatre. Yours. A denial is not a justification. Where an attacker answers civilian deaths by denying the attack rather than defending the target, it forecloses every defence the law makes available to it. The means were indiscriminate. The PrSM detonates fifteen to twenty metres above ground and disperses tens of thousands of tungsten fragments across a wide area. Investigators counted thousands of fragment impacts along a single 150-metre stretch of one residential street. The casualty pattern is not evidence of a strike gone wrong. It is evidence of the weapon working exactly as designed, in a place where its design guaranteed the result. And the strikes were successive. The first detonated above a sports hall where a girls' volleyball team was training. People ran into the open. The second fell on them. Then a third, then a fourth. Whatever might be argued about the first, nothing explains the rest except a decision taken with knowledge of what the first had just done. A city is not a proving ground. The PrSM had never been used in combat before that day. Lamerd was its debut, and Central Command's commander publicly praised that debut within days. It is sometimes assumed that validating a weapon under operational conditions is a military benefit that can be weighed in the balance. It cannot. The advantage the law requires must be "definite", "concrete and direct" — language chosen precisely to exclude benefits that are speculative, generalised or deferred. Performance data accrues to a production line, not to an attack. It belongs to no part of the balance a commander is permitted to strike. If the rationale was to observe the weapon's effects under live conditions, the civilians of Lamerd were not incidental to the object of the attack. They were the medium on which effectiveness was measured. The contract was made with knowledge. Complicity does not require sharing the perpetrator's purpose. It requires assistance having a substantial effect, furnished with knowledge. That is the standard on which the Hamburg court convicted the suppliers of Zyklon B in 1946; on which the Netherlands convicted Frans van Anraat for supplying chemical precursors to Iraq, holding expressly that the lawful commercial form of the transaction gave him no shelter; and which the French Cour de cassation confirmed reaches corporations in Lafarge. Your original contracts predate Lamerd. The expansion does not. By the time it was signed, the forensic record was public, the official account had collapsed twice, and CENTCOM had itself identified the operation as the weapon's combat debut. A prime contractor does not learn of its munition's first combat use from the newspapers. The expansion was not made in ignorance of how the weapon performed at Lamerd. It was made because of it. Your counsel will know that the corporation is not the principal exposure. Nuremberg did not try I.G. Farben or Krupp; it tried the men who ran them. Van Anraat went to prison as an individual. Officers who authorise continued manufacture and transfer after notice do so in their own names, in a world where Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, France, Spain, Sweden and others exercise universal jurisdiction over grave breaches. That exposure does not lapse, and it travels. Accordingly: rescind the expansion agreement; suspend production and transfer pending an independent forensic investigation; preserve and disclose the performance data you hold on the Lamerd employment, because it is evidence; and cooperate with any prosecuting authority that opens a file. Any pursuit of superintelligence has to be grounded in the core principle that if the AI we build is not helping humanity and under human control, it's not worth pursuing. We also need to accelerate and spread the benefits of AI, such that they are diffused broadly across countries, communities, and companies. This requires a frontier ecosystem in which both closed and open-source models can thrive. And for firms, it’s imperative that they retain full control over their unique and tacit knowledge. Every organization should be able to build its own continuous learning loop/hill climbing machine, without becoming dependent on any one model provider, and have the ability to embed its own knowledge into models and weights they control. So, in this context, we welcome the research, focus, and deliberate pacing needed to get alignment right as the design goal. We also welcome ideas like "embedded evaluators" and the broader efforts to develop the mechanisms to make this more than just talk. The key is that this cannot be controlled by a handful of entities, but must have broad representation across the ecosystem, countries, and fields, including academia. This is the approach we are taking: broad access and choice at every layer of the AI stack; enterprise control of learning loops and models; and the “Code of Conduct” that underlies our own first party MAI models that we’ll publish tomorrow for public consultation.

नरेंद्र मोदी जनता से वसूली का नया प्लान लाए हैं। अब ₹2,000 से ऊपर के UPI पेमेंट पर सरकार वसूली करेगी। प्लान है कि ₹2,000 से ऊपर के हर UPI पेमेंट पर 0.5% चार्ज वसूला जाए, मतलब - • अगर आपने ₹5,000 की खरीदारी की तो ₹25 का चार्ज लगेगा • अगर ₹10,000 की खरीदारी की तो ₹50 वसूला जाएगा पहले UPI पेमेंट पूरी तरह फ्री था, लेकिन नरेंद्र मोदी से ये देखा नहीं गया और यहां भी वसूली का खेल शुरू कर दिया। मोदी का फंडा साफ है - जितना हो सके जनता को लूट लो और अपने मित्र की तिजोरी भरो। ये सरकार जनता की सरकार नहीं है, ये चंद उद्योगपतियों की सरकार है और नरेंद्र मोदी उनके एजेंट।

Why BRICS is an exercise in realpolitik. But at the end of the day, voluntary standards made by a handful of tech companies won’t be enough. We need government – and specifically our leaders in Washington – to get proactive in coming up with concrete proposals, laws and regulations that deal with serious safety concerns, anticipate AI’s impact on jobs and our kids, and make sure that AI’s benefits are widely spread. And we need the U.S. to take the lead in creating international standards for AI safety. Given what we know about technology, we can’t stuff AI back in a box. But we can collectively determine how it's developed and how it’s used, rather than sitting back and letting AI and its fallout happen to us.

So, we need to use this time to structure a more open, public and democratic conversation about AI. Building on the statements that the frontier companies have already made, some leaders in the space announced they’re launching what they call Project Blueprint to help tech companies and policy makers work together on setting stronger standards and guidelines for AI development. Andrew Ross Sorkin (@andrewrsorkin) Breaking in @dealbook: Jay Carney is joining SV Angel, Ron Conway’s venture capital firm, to run a new initiative called Project Blueprint. Its purpose is to rebuild bonds between leaders in the artificial intelligence sector and Democrats who are demanding new rules to regulate the technology. nytimes.com/2026/09/14/busin… — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/andrewrsorkin/status/2099478917228769570#m

I was encouraged this week to see the leaders of the frontier labs agree on the need for them to slow down the pace of AI development. Given the stakes, it’s a good and necessary first step. But I’m even more encouraged by the growing recognition that how this powerful new technology develops should be at the center of our public debate. I’ve been watching the progress on AI for over a decade now, and one thing that’s clear to me is that the potential impact of this technology is not overhyped. It’s also moving at lightning speed – and even faster than those who are engineering it can keep up with. I’m not an AI accelerationist who believes it will lead to some techno-utopia, and I’m not a doomer who thinks it will inevitably lead to humanity’s destruction. But whether this technology results in amazing breakthroughs in medicine, energy and education or unleashes huge economic disruptions, greater inequality, and potential catastrophe will depend on the choices that we make right now – choices that should be made not just by the companies involved, but by all of us.

ⓉⓃ (@tesfanews) ETHIOPIA - ⚡️At the BRICS Summit in #India, Ethiopian leader once again put on his international-diplomacy costume and repackaged Ethiopia’s expansionist territorial and maritime ambitions as the innocent-sounding phrase “access to the sea.” For the past three years, Ethiopia’s leadership has pursued what amounts to a campaign to alter established borders and secure access to #Eritrea’s Red Sea coast, if necessary, through force. Yet before the international community and anything written for international audience, the same objective is presented as nothing more than an "economic necessity" for a growing economy. Abiy told the summit that access to the sea is “first and foremost an economic imperative,” requiring reliable and diversified trade routes, and assured the international audience that #Ethiopia would pursue it through “peaceful and negotiated arrangements.” Notably absent was the phrase “sovereign sea access,” or "𝑜𝑤𝑛𝑒𝑟𝑠ℎ𝑖𝑝" a central term in Ethiopia’s domestic rhetoric. For three years, Ethiopian officials, military commanders, and government-linked outlets have repeatedly portrayed Eritrea’s port of #Assab as an Ethiopian port, as if it were already theirs. Military figures have even threatened, in Amharic broadcasts aimed at domestic audiences, to seize Eritrean territory and ports by force if Eritrea does not hand them over willingly, as though Assab port were a piece of candy to be given away. But switch the language to English and face the international audience, and voilà: no threats, no territorial claims, no talk of taking anything. Suddenly, it is all peaceful negotiations, economic necessity, and international trade. Apparently, Ethiopia has two foreign policies: one for the domestic audience, where Assab is treated like property waiting to be reclaimed, and another for the international audience, where the same ambition is dressed up as an innocent request for economic access. This is not merely diplomatic inconsistency. It is political theater with two scripts: one written for domestic mobilization, the other for international consumption. The real question is not whether Ethiopia knows there is a contradiction. It clearly does. The question is whether it genuinely believes the rest of the world cannot see it. KD1 (Kaydee) has recently been seen in the nest with Shadow following the loss of Jackie. The band on KD1’s leg is more than an identification tag. It connects this eagle to the USGS’s Bird Banding Laboratory (BBL), which maintains more than 100 years of bird banding and encounter data. The BBL manages more than 7,700 federal bird banding and marking permits and distributes more than 1 million bird bands each year. These data help scientists study bird movements, survival and populations. Bald eagles are a powerful example of why this long-term science matters. Once severely threatened by contaminants such as DDT, their populations have made an extraordinary comeback. From one banded eagle to more than a century of data, every observation helps tell the story. Learn more about why we band birds: ow.ly/Mhfr50ZLyCw 📷: Image courtesy of Friends of Big Bear Valley

In Sochi, Krasnodar Krai, russian federation, a 92N6 multifunctional radar station belonging to the S-400 Triumf surface-to-air missile system was hit. ℹ️ Background. The 92N6 is a multifunctional radar station that tracks airborne targets and guides surface-to-air missiles towards them. Within the S-400 system, it is one of the key elements responsible for carrying out the system’s air defence engagement tasks. In the areas of Kursk, Kursk region, russian federation, and Donetsk, sites used for the storage, preparation and launch of attack UAVs were hit. In Novohrodivka, Donetsk region, an enemy UAV unit command post was also hit. Enemy radar stations were hit in the areas of Lityzh, Trostenchyk and Lypovets, Bryansk region, russian federation. Statement by the CARICOM Eminent Persons Group on the visit to Haiti, 2-9 September 2026 The CARICOM Eminent Persons Group (EPG) visited Haiti from 2-9 September 2026 and held discussions with a large number, and broad range, of political and civil society stakeholders including the business community, youth, women and human rights organisations, key government institutions and the leadership of the Gang Suppression Force (GSF). The visit of the EPG also provided a timely opportunity to assess the political conjuncture and to engage in dialogue on the preparations for the first round of elections scheduled for 13 December 2026. The EPG observed several positive developments, including the work being undertaken to reignite an election process after more than ten years. The EPG noted that political parties were in various stages of preparation to participate in the forthcoming elections, including by forming political groupings. Stakeholders also expressed their views and concerns on the new measures required by the amended Electoral Decree. They claimed that many of these measures were unwieldy and onerous. They were particularly concerned by the number of documents candidates were required to provide to the Electoral Council (CEP) and the slow pace of the registration of electors. It was drawn to the attention of the EPG that the voter registration process was not meeting expectations. The process was constricted by the existence of territories beyond state control. Many of the stakeholders emphasized the need for greater public sensitisation on the process and wider availability of registration centres, Though striving to comply with the demands required to participate in the elections, a number of parties called for modification of some of the procedures and requirements that might necessitate a deferment of the December 13 election date. Stakeholders however expressed a yearning for fair, credible, impartial and inclusive elections to bring an end to the successive transitional arrangements that have been an unwelcome feature of the multidimensional crisis in Haiti. The security situation remains of particular concern. The EPG noted the recent spread and spike in deadly violence and kidnappings, as well as the challenges contributing to the slow deployment of the GSF. In their discussions, all stakeholders underscored the critical importance of ensuring a security environment that will allow for country-wide registration of voters, political campaigning, freedom of movement and for citizens to vote safely. Deployment of the additional forces and resources pledged by various countries and strategic operational coordination among these and the Haitian security forces are of paramount importance in achieving this objective. Haiti is at a critical juncture. With important steps being taken by Haitians towards stability and a return to democratic governance in their country, the EPG calls on international partners to refocus efforts to deliver with despatch on security commitments made to ensure the implementation of UN Security Council Resolution 2793. 14 September 2026

Every morning, before we even leave the house to school, my Grok Bot has already generated and printed fresh math worksheets for my kids. I don’t need to do nothing, it prints every day at 6am.. The papers are just sitting on my printer... ready to go. My 8 yr old is in 3rd grade. He gets 20 mixed problems that include multi-digit multiplication, exact division, addition, subtraction, and solve-for-X. My 5 yr old is in kindergarten. He gets 25 single-digit addition and subtraction problems. The worksheets are truly randomized with no repeats, black and white to save ink, plenty of room to work, a little quote at the top to start their day on the right note… and gets a bit more challenging depending on how they did the day before. Then it generates one combined answer key for me so I can check both of them fast at the end of the ride. Then, we just get in my Tesla, I turn on FSD, and instead of spending the whole drive focused on operating the car, I can focus on them and their development. I can sit with them. “What did you get for this one?” “Show me how you got there.” “Try that one again.” When one of them gets stuck, I’m there, like a private tutor, except I’m the Dad. In Silicon Valley, many families obsess over which math program, class, app, or curriculum is best and do a lot of crazy things tbh. And sure, I guess those things matter to a degree. But kids gotta be kids, and I don’t need to make learning complicated. I have Grok Bot. Every morning it gives each of my kids work that matches exactly where they’re at. Then tomorrow, it does it again. And again. And again. That consistency matters more to me than finding some “perfect” program. I care about habit and good habits add up. A week becomes hundreds of problems. A school year becomes thousands. And the whole thing happens during time we were already going to spend in the car anyway. That’s what I love about this setup that is enabled from the products of Elon’s companies. AI handles the repetitive stuff. Grok Bot creates the work, randomizes it, formats it, prints it at 6 AM, and makes my answer key. Tesla FSD handles the drive. And I get the part that actually matters… Sitting next to my kids. Watching how they think. Seeing where they struggle. Explaining something a different way when it doesn’t click. Giving them a little confidence when they get frustrated. And watching them get better over time. I’m really not trying to turn every morning into school… I hated school, I know how it is. I’m just using technology to create a small daily habit that would’ve taken a lot more effort before. This is where AI quietly is removing removes friction from my life every single day. And ultimately making me a better Dad and raising stronger children.

Remittances are one of the world’s most resilient sources of household finance, supporting more than 1.1 billion people. The 2026 #SendingMoneyHome report, released today by the IFAD-administered Financing Facility for Remittances (FFR), examines how these flows changed over the past decade and explores the impact of migrant workers’ remittances on families, communities and development in low- and middle-income countries. Key findings show that: 🔹Remittance flows nearly doubled: Asia still receives half, Latin America grew fastest and flows to Africa nearly doubled. 🔹Around 220 million migrant workers send money home worldwide and by 2030, migrants and diaspora are expected to send more than US$3.6 trillion cumulatively to their home countries. 🔹About 1/3 of these remittances go to rural areas, where they can also open pathways to savings, insurance and investment in enterprises and other livelihood opportunities. The report’s findings and recommendations provide a practical basis for action by both the public and private sectors. Download the 2026 Sending Money Home report at ifad.org/en/w/news/remittanc… #FinancingTheFirstMile | @FFRemittances Video

Remittance inflows to low- and middle-income countries reached US$728.6 billion in 2025 – more than four times global official development assistance that year and greater than foreign direct investment to those countries, according to the 2026 Sending Money Home report launched today by IFAD. According to the report, remittances have remained one of the world's largest and most consistent sources of household finance over the past decade, helping families meet basic needs, build resilience and invest in their futures, even in times of crisis. “As remittances help families meet their basic needs, they are also building financial growth and resilience to shocks,” said @IFADPresident Alvaro Lario. “Their potential benefits are greatest when families have access to affordable and trusted financial services, together with the knowledge, freedom and appropriate options to use their resources according to their own needs and aspirations,” added Lario. The findings highlight opportunities for policymakers to strengthen the impact of remittances on resilience, financial inclusion and economic opportunity while recognizing that these private flows cannot replace public investment, social protection or climate finance. Read more at ifad.org/en/w/news/remittanc… #FinancingTheFirstMile #SendingMoneyHome | @FFRemittances

The Houthi campaign has expanded to attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure and advances toward the Bab al Mandeb Strait, including the reported seizure of Perim Island and positions along Yemen’s Red Sea coast. Adm. Cooper’s visit follows reports that Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman twice contacted President Donald J. Trump on Thursday seeking urgent U.S. military assistance against the Houthis. The Trump administration has so far declined to authorize direct U.S. strikes, but has agreed to provide Saudi Arabia with intelligence and targeting support.

Earlier today, the Houthis announced a large-scale wave of strikes against King Khalid Air Base in Khamis Mushait, Saudi Arabia. A commensurate release from Saudi Arabia’s Directorate of Civil Defense announced an alert for the same area during the strikes.

Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, today met with Ms. Yevhenia Shynkarenko, Chargé d’Affaires of the Embassy of Ukraine in Jakarta, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat, during which both sides discussed ways to promote relations between ASEAN and Ukraine.

Ambassador of the State of Qatar to ASEAN, Dr. Sultan bin Mubarak Saad Al-Dosari, presented his Letter of Credence to Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat today. Secretary-General Dr. Kao congratulated Ambassador Al-Dosari on his appointment and looked forward to working closely with him to further advance ASEAN-Qatar relations, particularly following the conferment of ASEAN Sectoral Dialogue Partner (SDP) status on Qatar at the 59th ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Meeting on 21 July 2026, in Manila, the Philippines. He encouraged Qatar to work closely with ASEAN Member States and the ASEAN Secretariat to substantiate the newly established SDP. He further highlighted potential areas of cooperation between ASEAN and Qatar, including education and human resource development, public health, economic empowerment, climate change and environmental cooperation, disaster resilience, and capacity building. Ambassador Al-Dosari expressed Qatar’s commitment to enhancing its engagement with ASEAN and ASEAN Member States and to further strengthening cooperation under the newly established SDP. Both sides also looked forward to developing the ASEAN-Qatar Practical Cooperation Areas (2027-2031), which will serve as practical roadmap for implementing cooperation under ASEAN-Qatar SDP and further substantiate the partnership over the next five years. Qatar acceded to the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia in 2022 and has accredited its Ambassador to ASEAN since 2017. Ambassador Al-Dosari succeeds Ambassador Fawziya Bint Edrees Salman Al-Sulaiti, who completed her tenure on 17 May 2024. Ambassador Al-Dosari is the third Ambassador of Qatar to ASEAN.

The Iran war is changing again, and not in a good way: 1. Iran is expanding the war horizontally, with attacks on new sites and with new actors, away from the central U.S.-Iran battlefield. 2. The nightmare oil scenario is both a closed Strait of Hormuz and a blocked Nab el-Mandeb. That’s what Iran is now trying for, adding overland infrastructure to the mix as well. 3. The Houthis have recently seized a port and an island in the Red Sea. Iranian proxies based in Iraq attacked Saudi energy infrastructure with drones. The Saudis turned off their East-West pipeline. 4. Mohammed bin Salman reportedly asked the U.S. to join the fight against the Houthis. Trump apparently said no. Interestingly but not surprisingly, Turkey and Pakistan aren’t fighting for Saudi either, despite their brand-new trilateral defense agreement. 5. Trump is no doubt wary of restarting a fight like the one last year, in which the U.S. spent weeks, and lots of resources, bombing Houthi positions to free up Red Sea. It didn’t work. The U.S. cut a deal with the Houthis rather than defeat them militarily. 6. Despite that, it’s hard to see the U.S. sitting idle if the Houthis continue to advance. You could well see American involvement in Yemen and in the Strait simultaneously. 7. Step back and you can see a new Iranian strategy. As the Strait becomes less important - more ships moving through, more alternative pathways established - Tehran threatens the alternatives. In the meantime, it continues firing on ships transiting the Strait. 8. The U.S. says traffic through the Strait is returning toward prewar levels. I’ve heard from allied governments who believe the numbers are overstated. And global oil prices don’t suggest a restoration. 9. Tomorrow Iranian officials are meeting with Gulf leaders. Previously the Gulf worried that the U.S. would reach a peace agreement with Tehran that left them dangerously exposed. With U.S.-Iran talks stalled, Washington has to worry about its Gulf allies cutting deals with Tehran to protect themselves. 10. That could mean recognizing some degree of Iranian authority over the Strait, which is precisely what the U.S. has tried to avoid. 11. Trump predicts the war will end right after the midterm elections. I doubt it. With the horizontal escalation we are seeing now, it’s likelier that this has at least months more to go.

It seems most people don't understand how severe the energy situation is right now in the Middle East. As of Friday, Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline has officially been shut down after recent attacks, putting -4 million barrels of daily oil exports at risk. Meanwhile, the Bab el-Mandeb Strait is now at risk of being shut down, threatening up to -9 million barrels of daily oil supply. All while the Strait of Hormuz is operating at ~20% of its pre-Iran War capacity, removing -15 million barrels of daily oil flows. Combined, this represents nearly ~30 MILLION barrels per day of oil flows that are either offline or at risk. Even after accounting for some overlap between these routes, the scale of the potential disruption is enormous relative to the ~100 million barrel per day global oil market. This is one of the most severe energy supply situations in modern history.

⚡️⚡️ 92N6 radar from the S-400 Triumf system, attack UAV launch sites and enemy control assets hit On 13th September and during the night of 14th September 2026, units of the Defence Forces of Ukraine struck a number of important military targets of the russian aggressor. In Sochi, Krasnodar Krai, russian federation, a 92N6 multifunctional radar station belonging to the S-400 Triumf surface-to-air missile system was hit. ℹ️ Background. The 92N6 is a multifunctional radar station that tracks airborne targets and guides surface-to-air missiles towards them. Within the S-400 system, it is one of the key elements responsible for carrying out the system’s air defence engagement tasks. In the areas of Kursk, Kursk region, russian federation, and Donetsk, sites used for the storage, preparation and launch of attack UAVs were hit. In Novohrodivka, Donetsk region, an enemy UAV unit command post was also hit. Enemy radar stations were hit in the areas of Lityzh, Trostenchyk and Lypovets, Bryansk region, russian federation. Near the Saky airfield in temporarily occupied Crimea, an occupier short-range radio navigation system was hit. In addition, three enemy repeaters were hit in Rokhmanove, Krasnyi Stiah and Kamin, Bryansk region, russian federation. The extent of the damage is being assessed. Operations against key military targets of the russian aggressor are ongoing. To be continued! 💥 Glory to Ukraine! 🇺🇦

Planted Avicennia marina, a species of Mangrove, in the Jakhau Mangrove Nursery in Kutch, Gujarat. Under the MISHTI (Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats & Tangible Incomes) programme initiated by PM Shri @narendramodi ji, Kutch is undertaking large-scale mangrove restoration, scientific nursery development and livelihood initiatives. Against a cumulative plantation target of 29,250 hectares for 2023–24 to 2026–27, mangrove plantation has been completed over 27,652 hectares, including 12,450 hectares in the Kori Creek area. Approximately 3.49 lakh mangrove seedlings have been raised at the Jakhau Mangrove Nursery. Interacted with subject experts to understand the challenges and technological and nature-based solutions to address the same. Kutch is developing a comprehensive model of mangrove conservation by combining large-scale plantation, nurseries, biodiversity conservation, innovative tidal technology, renewable energy, community participation and sustainable livelihoods. Jakhau Mangrove Nursery is a significant example of technology-driven and community-oriented mangrove restoration in Gujarat.

कांग्रेस पार्टी और राहुल गांधी आजकल बहुत बड़े-बड़े भाषण दे रहे हैं और उधर उनकी सरकारों में अलग-अलग तरीके के भ्रष्टाचार के नए स्वरूप सामने आ रहे हैं। कर्नाटक के PWD मिनिस्टर सतीश जारकीहोली जी के यहां पड़े छापों में सिर्फ इतनी ही बात सामने नहीं आई है कि कितनी संपत्ति है, यह भी बात सामने आई है कि उन लोगों ने विदेश में कई जगह सोने की खदानें ली थीं। इस प्रकार के तथ्य प्रकाश में आए हैं, इस प्रकार की जानकारी मीडिया में आई है कि कांगो और जाम्बिया जैसी जगहों पर भी माइनिंग के इन्वेस्टमेंट के सबूत मिले हैं। अर्थात् कांग्रेस पार्टी के शासनकाल में भ्रष्टाचार वैश्विक रूप धारण कर चुका है। इनके नेता प्रतिपक्ष देश-विदेश घूमते हैं और इनके नेता देश-विदेश में जाकर इन्वेस्टमेंट करते हैं। गंभीर बात ये है कि कांग्रेस पार्टी भारतीय समाज को तोड़ने के लिए intellectual investment बाहर से अपने दिमाग में लाती है और भ्रष्टाचार करके financial investment अपनी सरकारों से ले जाकर विदेश में करती है। कांग्रेस का यह बहुत खतरनाक चरित्र सामने है कि भारतीय समाज को बांटो, तोड़ो, टकराहट पैदा करो और इसके लिए फॉर्मूले, थ्योरियां और भ्रामक सामग्री विदेश से प्राप्त करो और फिर यहां से भ्रष्टाचार करके देश की जनता की गाढ़ी कमाई का पैसा अपनी जेबों में भरकर विदेश की खदानों में लेकर जाकर स्थापित करो। कर्नाटक की जनता बहुत गंभीरता से इस विषय को देख रही है और इसका करारा जवाब देगी। - डॉ. @SudhanshuTrived Video
